title: Data & IT Cost Analyst
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Data \& IT Cost Analyst
   

  

**Department** 
 : IT CARATS
   

  

**About Business line/Function:** 
 BNP Paribas Cardif is the insurance subsidiary of BNP Paribas. We are a worldwide leader of the Credit Protection Insurance market with strong positions in savings and protection insurance in more than 30 countries in Europe, Asia and Latin America.
   

  

 The IT Asset Management and Optimization (ITAMO) service within the IT Department is responsible for managing IT assets to improve control over operational risks and costs. This service globally oversees Cardif’s asset registers and IT management tools to support compliance and risk‑management requirements for our IT activities and to control spending and investments related to our IT footprint. In this regard, the service monitors the health of IT assets by identifying critical components (under‑utilization, toxicity, etc.), helps reduce software spending through the rationalization of publisher contracts and usage, and finally facilitates the identification of optimizations for infrastructure‑service expenditures delivered by the Group’s IT providers.
   

  

**Position Purpose**
 Data \& IT Cost Analyst – GIE BNPP Cardif (Confirmed)
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced cost control\-oriented Data Analyst to join our IT team.
   

  

 In this role, you sit at the intersection of data analytics and financial operations, with a clear mandate: bring visibility, rigor, and actionable intelligence to IT infrastructure costs across our application and server assets (PROD and non\-PROD environments).
   

  

 You will own the full cost analytics cycle — from data collection and modelling, through trend analysis and anomaly detection, to executive\-level reporting and recommendation delivery.
   

  

 Your work will directly influence infrastructure spending decisions and resource optimization strategies across the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Direct Responsibilities
   

  

**Cost \& Resource Analytics**
* Analyse and interpret data related to applications, servers, and PROD / non\-PROD environments, covering:
* Technical unit consumption volumes — CPU, memory, storage, bandwidth, etc.
* Cost attribution — server costs, storage costs, network costs, and associated resource expenditure.
* Application and server performance — response times, availability rates, SLA compliance.
* Identify cost trends, consumption anomalies, and financial risk signals across the IT estate, and translate them into concrete optimisation recommendations.
* Build cost allocation models and showback/chargeback frameworks to provide accurate visibility of IT spending by team, application, or service.
* Monitor budget vs. actual consumption and flag deviations proactively to relevant stakeholders.


 Dashboard Development \& Reporting
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports that present cost and performance data to both operational teams and senior leadership.
* Ensure dashboards provide real\-time or near\-real\-time visibility into spending patterns, capacity usage, and efficiency KPIs.
* Manage dashboard access rights and audience segmentation across stakeholder groups.


 Insight Generation \& Decision Support
   

  

* Conduct focused case studies and ad\-hoc financial analyses to address specific business questions — e.g. cost of a migration, impact of a decommission, ROI of a right\-sizing initiative.
* Develop and implement analytical models and decision\-support tools that improve data\-driven financial management.
* Participate in the continuous improvement of data analysis processes, reporting standards, and cost governance practices.


 Stakeholder Engagement \& Communication
   

  

* Partner with operational and finance teams to understand cost drivers, validate findings, and align on recommendations.
* Deliver clear, impactful presentations of analytical results and financial recommendations to both operational teams and senior leadership (CODIR level).
* Act as a trusted advisor on IT cost matters, bridging the gap between technical infrastructure data and financial decision making.


**Technical \& Behavioral Competencies**
* Advanced proficiency in Power BI — dashboard design, DAX, data modelling, cost reporting.
* Strong SQL skills for querying and aggregating financial and operational datasets.
* Proven ability to identify cost trends, anomalies, and savings opportunities from complex datasets.
* Experience with tools such as Excel (advanced), SQL, Power BI, Python, or R.
* Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools (Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, etc.).
* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure cost management — servers, storage, network, applications, PROD vs. non\-PROD environments.


**Technical Skills**
* PowerBI (advanced)
* MS Excel (advanced)
* Python


**Behavioral Skills**
* Excellent communication skills — ability to present financial insights clearly and with impact to non\-technical and executive audiences
* Ability to work autonomously
* Ability to manage multiple analytical workstreams simultaneously
* Ability to manage priorities


**Education Level:** 
 Master Degree or equivalent
   

  

**Professional Experience level:** 
 At least 5 years
   

  

**Location:** 
 Chennai
   

  

**About BNP Paribas Group**
 BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
   

  

**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
 Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best\-in\-class solutions.
   

  

**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
 At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. title: Data Analytics Intermediate Analyst
description:
The Data Analytics Intmd Analyst is a Governance and developing professional role. The incumbent deals with most problems independently and has some latitude to solve complex problems. This role integrates in\-depth specialty area knowledge with a solid understanding of industry standards and practices, and demonstrates a good understanding of how the team and area integrate with others in accomplishing the objectives of the subfunction/job family.
   

  

 The role applies analytical thinking and knowledge of data analysis tools and methodologies, requiring attention to detail when making judgments and recommendations based on the analysis of factual information. In addition to core analytics duties, this role also incorporates elements of
 **data governance and data risk \& control awareness** 
 , requiring the ability to handle ambiguity and complexity, and to partner across teams on governance\-related initiatives. The individual typically deals with variable issues with potentially broader business impact, applies professional judgment when interpreting data and results, and breaks down information in a systematic and communicable manner.
   

  

 Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required to exchange potentially complex/sensitive information and to guide and influence stakeholders on governance\-related matters. This role has a moderate but direct impact through close contact with the businesses' core activities; the quality and timeliness of service provided will affect the effectiveness of the analyst's own team as well as other closely related teams.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Core Data Analytics Responsibilities
   

  

* Integrates in\-depth data analysis knowledge with a solid understanding of industry standards and practices.
* Demonstrates a good understanding of how data analytics teams and area integrate with others in accomplishing objectives.
* Applies project management skills.
* Applies analytical thinking and knowledge of data analysis tools and methodologies.
* Analyzes factual information to make accurate judgments and recommendations focused on local operations and broader impacts.
* Applies professional judgment when interpreting data and results, breaking down information in a systematic and communicable manner.
* Employs developed communication and diplomacy skills to exchange potentially complex/sensitive information.
* Demonstrates attention to quality and timeliness of service to ensure the effectiveness of the team and group.
* Provides informal guidance or on\-the\-job training to new team members.
* Appropriately assesses risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients, and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct, and business practices, and escalating, managing, and reporting control issues with transparency.
* Partners with multiple teams to support the implementation of relevant Data Governance policies and/or the Data Risk and Control framework as applicable to the analytics function.
* Provides input and support on Data Governance and/or Data Risk and Controls framework matters, including performance monitoring and self\-assessment processes related to data used in analysis.
* Supports oversight and analysis of data\-related issues, including tracking of ownership, target dates, and associated metrics and reporting.
* Gathers and synthesizes metrics on existing Data Governance and/or Data Risk and Controls principles, policies, practices, and standards, including awareness of industry best practices, to inform data analytics work
* Assists in establishing and maintaining the Industry Governance Policy execution framework, including data cataloging, data lineage, and data quality capabilities
* Evaluates business processes to align with regulatory requirements and internal governance standards


**Qualifications**
 Core Qualifications
   

  

* 4\-8 years of relevant experience
* Knowledge of tools for statistical modeling of large data sets.
* Ability to effectively use complex analytical, interpretive, and problem\-solving techniques.
* Demonstrated interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
* Working knowledge of Data Governance and/or Data Risk and Control principles, policies, and frameworks (e.g., data policy adoption, data quality, and issue management processes) is a plus.
* Ability to handle ambiguity and complexity, and to adapt quickly to changing requirements.
* Good analytical skills to filter, prioritize, and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources
* Hands\-on experience with GitHub — including repository management, branching, pull requests, and version control best practices
* Familiarity with Lightspeed (LSE/LSC) or equivalent enterprise CI/CD platforms — understanding of build pipelines, deployment workflows, and DevOps\-integrated environments
* Experience with data cataloging, data lineage, or metadata management tools is a plus
* Applies digital skills, including the use of AI\-assisted tools, to enhance BAU (Business\-as\-Usual) activities and improve governance efficiency

description:
**Company Description** 
 Minus 30 Private Limited is a gelato brand that reimagines classic desserts with imaginative flavors and simple indulgences. The company is inspired by nostalgic memories of home\-made chocolate ice cream that was fresh, preservative\-free, and made with care. Minus 30 focuses on creating high\-quality, wholesome gelato that brings joy and a sense of familiarity to customers. Team members are part of a culture that values creativity, craftsmanship, and a genuine love for food. The company is growing and offers opportunities for individuals who want to contribute to a distinctive food experience.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Data Analyst role based in Bengaluru. The Data Analyst will collect, clean, and analyze data from sales, operations, marketing, and production to generate insights that support business decisions. Responsibilities include building reports and dashboards, tracking key performance indicators, and identifying trends in customer behavior and product performance. The role involves collaborating with cross\-functional teams to translate data findings into actionable recommendations, improve forecasting, and optimize inventory and supply chain processes. The Data Analyst will also support ad hoc analysis, maintain data quality, and present findings in clear, accessible formats for stakeholders.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and Data Analytics capabilities to interpret complex datasets and derive actionable insights.
* Candidates should possess a solid foundation in Statistics to support forecasting, hypothesis testing, and performance measurement.
* Candidates should possess competencies in Data Modeling to design and maintain structured data sets and reporting frameworks.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to present findings, create clear reports, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency in tools such as Excel, SQL, and data visualization platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or similar) is beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field is preferred.
* Experience in FMCG, food and beverage, or retail analytics is an advantage.
* Ability to work on\-site in Bengaluru, manage multiple priorities, and maintain attention to detail in a fast\-paced environment.

title: Lead Analyst/ Associate Consultant-Power BI with paginated reports
description:
Position Description
   

  

 Company Profile:
   

  

 Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end\-to\-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14\.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.
   

  

 Position: Lead Analyst/ Associate Consultant\-Power BI with paginated reports
   

  

 Experience: 8\-12 years
   

  

 Category: Software Development/ Engineering
   

  

 Shift Timing: 12:00 PM to 10:00 PM
   

  

 Location: Chennai
   

  

 Position ID: J0326\-2348
   

  

 Employment Type: Full Time
   

  

 Education Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 8 years of relevant experience.
   

  

 We are seeking a hands\-on Enterprise Power BI Architect to define, design, and govern the BI architecture across programs and client accounts. This role focuses on building scalable, secure, and high\-performance reporting solutions that enable data\-driven decision\-making.
   

  

 The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, data engineering teams, and delivery leads to translate business needs into enterprise reporting frameworks. The role requires a strong combination of Power BI technical expertise, architectural thinking, governance, and stakeholder engagement.
   

  

 This is an individual contributor role focused on architecture and delivery oversight, rather than people management.
   

  

 Your future duties and responsibilities
   

  

 Architecture \& Solution Design
   

  

 Design, develop, and oversee Power BI dashboards, reports, and paginated reports aligned with business requirements.
   

  

 Define and maintain enterprise\-level Power BI architecture standards, patterns, and best practices.
   

  

 Architect scalable semantic models, reusable data models, and enterprise reporting frameworks.
   

  

 Establish reusable data models, KPI frameworks, and visualization standards across domains.
   

  

 Define and enforce data security strategies, including Row\-Level Security (RLS), access governance, and workspace security.
   

  

 Drive performance optimization across datasets, data models, reports, and enterprise workspaces.
   

  

 Optimize data models, datasets, and report performance for enterprise\-scale deployments.
   

  

 Governance \& Strategy
   

  

 Define and enforce BI governance standards including naming conventions, workspace strategy, and deployment pipelines.
   

  

 Collaborate with data engineering teams to align reporting with data warehouse, lakehouse, and analytics platforms.
   

  

 Evaluate existing reporting solutions and recommend modernization and architecture improvements.
   

  

 Ensure data governance, compliance, and security standards are maintained.
   

  

 Act as a steward for analytics platform maturity and standardization across accounts.
   

  

 Stakeholder Engagement \& Leadership
   

  

 Lead architecture discussions with business stakeholders, program leaders, and clients.
   

  

 Translate business strategy and analytical needs into actionable reporting and architecture roadmaps.
   

  

 Clearly articulate trade\-offs, risks, scalability considerations, and remediation strategies to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
   

  

 Provide solution architecture support for presales, estimations, and strategic initiatives.
   

  

 Delivery Enablement \& Team Leadership
   

  

 Guide BI developers and tech leads on data modeling, DAX optimization, and Power BI best practices.
   

  

 Conduct architecture reviews, design validations, and solution quality assessments.
   

  

 Enable DevOps, CI/CD, automation, and monitoring practices for Power BI solutions.
   

  

 Mentor teams and promote enterprise BI delivery maturity and technical excellence.
   

  

**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

 8\+ years of experience in Business Intelligence / Data Analytics.
   

  

 5\+ years of hands\-on Power BI experience in enterprise environments.
   

  

 Design, develop, and oversee interactive Power BI dashboards, reports, and paginated reports.
   

  

 Strong expertise in:
   

  

 Advanced data modeling (Star Schema, Snowflake, Composite Models)
   

  

 DAX optimization and performance tuning
   

  

 Power Query / data transformation
   

  

 Row\-Level Security (RLS) and Power BI governance
   

  

 Strong SQL skills with understanding of data warehouse architecture.
   

  

 Experience with Azure / SQL Server\-based analytics platforms.
   

  

 Experience implementing DevOps / CI\-CD pipelines for Power BI.
   

  

 Strong stakeholder communication and architectural leadership capabilities.
   

  

 Good to Have
   

  

 Experience with Microsoft Fabric.
   

  

 Exposure to data lakes, lakehouse architecture, and modern analytics platforms.
   

  

 Experience implementing monitoring, observability, and automation frameworks for BI solutions.
   

  

 Experience working in large\-scale or multi\-account delivery environments.
   

  

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**
 Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…
   

  

 You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.
   

  

 Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.
   

  

 You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
   

  

 That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.
   

  

 Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

**Risk Consulting – Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) – Staff**
**Description**
 EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry\-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker\-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process \& controls.
   

  

 Within EY’s Risk Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset\-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As part of the financial analysis of the bank’s exposures to a diverse range of public, semi‑public, and private counterparties \- including local authorities and their affiliates, public institutions, sovereigns, public financial institutions, SPVs, corporates, PPP/concession companies, and sponsors \- analysts will support credit‑risk assessments and contribute to internal‑rating activities across France and key international markets (primarily France, Italy, Spain, the UK, and, to a lesser extent, the US).
   

  

**Core Responsibilities:**
* Support the collection, quality review, and analysis of financial statements and key risk data for relevant counterparties.
* Assist in the preparation, structuring, and validation of input files and data flows used in rating processes and engines.
* Contribute to the drafting of financial analysis reports / credit memos, including key drivers, risks/mitigants, and preliminary views on ratings/outlooks, under supervision.
* Perform controls and reconciliations to ensure data quality, completeness, and consistency prior to processing.
* For French public sector entities, support data preprocessing and preparation of inputs for mass processing in the rating engine (as applicable).
* Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to support day\-to\-day operations and contribute to process improvements and documentation updates.
* Build, review, and validate financial models with strong command of Excel;
* Analyze large datasets and generate comparative insights (experience with Power BI/SQL is an advantage).


**Domain Skills Required:**
* Conduct in‑depth financial analysis, including detailed review of public‑sector and corporate financial statements (IFRS/French GAAP), ratio assessments (leverage, coverage, liquidity), evaluation of working capital requirements, and comprehensive cash‑flow analysis.
* Apply project‑finance principles to assess SPV cash‑flow structures, DSCR/LLCR metrics, debt‑sizing considerations, covenant frameworks, reserve mechanisms, security packages, and risk‑allocation structures across concession and PPP projects.
* Evaluate sovereign and quasi‑sovereign credit risk by analyzing institutional frameworks, governance quality, policy stability, and levels of explicit or implicit government support.
* Perform corporate and sectoral assessments by analyzing business models, industry dynamics, competitive positioning (utilities, transportation, energy, social infrastructure), and conducting sensitivity and benchmarking analyses across markets.
* Review and interpret financing documentation, including term sheets, loan documentation, covenant packages, guarantees, and where applicable key provisions within bond indentures.
* Prepare clear, structured, and analytically sound credit memoranda, including rating recommendations, risk/mitigation assessments, and identification of early‑warning indicators.
* Support and conduct gap assessments, impact analyses, and business‑readiness evaluations related to regulatory change initiatives.
* Demonstrate strong technical expertise and up‑to‑date industry knowledge across financial products, market practices, and risk methodologies.
* Lead key workstreams within large‑scale client engagements or independently manage smaller engagements, ensuring consistent delivery of high‑quality outcomes.
* Review outputs prepared by team members to ensure analytical quality, completeness, and adherence to internal standards.
* Stay informed of emerging trends, regulatory changes, and sector‑specific developments to anticipate client needs and strengthen advisory delivery.
* Monitor project progress, proactively manage risks, and communicate priorities, challenges, and updates effectively to stakeholders.
* Mentor and guide junior consultants, fostering skill development, knowledge sharing, and professional growth within the team.


**Qualifications, Certifications And Education**
**Must\-have:**
* Master’s degree in Business Administration (Finance/Economics) or CA qualification, with 1\-4 years of relevant experience in financial analysis or risk‑related roles.
* Foundational experience (internship/apprenticeship/junior role) in financial analysis, credit risk, audit, or corporate finance.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, core credit risk principles, and familiarity with project finance, corporate, or sovereign risk concepts.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, with foundational knowledge of Power BI and/or SQL considered a plus.
* Working knowledge of Risk Management, Regulatory Compliance, and Financial Reporting frameworks.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with business and technical stakeholders, including senior leadership.
* Demonstrated automation and innovation mindset, with willingness to improve processes and tools.
* Strong command of written and spoken professional English.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly.


**Good\-to\-have:**
* Professional certifications such as FRM, CFA, or PRM.
* Regulatory exposure or experience in areas such as Credit Underwriting, Basel frameworks, and CCAR.
* Familiarity with risk‑management systems, tools, or platforms.
* Willingness to travel based on client or project requirements.
* Previous project management experience
* Proficiency in French is highly advantageous and may be required for certain engagements.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

The role sits at the heart of the first line of defense for regulatory reporting, ensuring that all reportable transactions are submitted accurately, completely and on time to the relevant Trade Repositories and Approved Reporting Mechanisms across jurisdictions.
   

  

 Reporting to the Regulatory Transaction Reporting team, the Production Analyst works as part of a team with interchangeable resources, each expected to operate across all four regulatory regimes and across both EU and UK jurisdictions where applicable. This versatility is essential to ensure business continuity, balance workload across the team, and provide a single, consistent operating standard regardless of the reporting regime. For SFTR and MiFID II, the Analyst is responsible for the hands\-on day\-to\-day production of regulatory reporting. For EMIR and ASIC, which are delegated, the Analyst is responsible for the oversight and monitoring of the production performed by the service provider, ensuring reporting obligations are met.
   

  

 The role combines hands\-on production (SFTR, MiFID II), oversight of outsourced reporting performed (EMIR OTC, ASIC), oversight of delegated EMIR reporting on ETD performed by clearing brokers, exception remediation, accuracy controls, reconciliations, pairing \& matching, and reporting to senior stakeholders. It requires strong attention to detail, an in\-depth understanding of regulatory reporting mechanics across EU and UK regimes, and the ability to challenge and monitor an outsourced provider as effectively as performing the reporting directly.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* OVERSIGHT \& MONITORING OF OUTSOURCED REPORTING EMIR EU, EMIR UK, ASIC


 Perform daily oversight of the EMIR EU and UK scopes, and ASIC reporting production carried out by 3rd party Service Provider (SP), ensuring completeness, accuracy and timeliness of all reporting to DTCC.
   

  

 Monitor 3rd party SP daily production, submission status and exception handling, and challenge the provider where standards are not met.
   

  

 Review and validate the controls performed 3rd party SP, ensuring they are operating effectively and evidenced.
   

  

 Reconcile the internal trade population against the reports submitted by 3rd party SP to identify missing, duplicated or incorrectly reported transactions.
   

  

 Track and escalate persistent issues, recurring exceptions or SLA breaches by 3rd party SP to RTR team.
   

  

 Maintain documented evidence of the oversight performed, supporting second\-line oversight and internal/external audit requirements.
   

  

 Act as the point of contact for 3rd party SP on EMIR EU and UK scopes, and ASIC production matters.
   

  

* DAILY TRADE AND TRANSACTION REPORTING ACROSS SFTR (EU AND UK), MIFID II (EU AND UK)


 Execute daily production reporting, ensuring all reportable trades and transactions are submitted within the regulatory deadlines.
   

  

 Monitor reporting platforms and intraday flows to ensure timely capture and submission of all reportable events.
   

  

 Validate report content against source systems post submission.
   

  

 Track submission status and ensure all reports reach a final accepted state by Trade Repository or ARM/APA.
   

  

* REJECTIONS AND EXCEPTIONS REMEDIATION


 Investigate and remediate all rejections (NACKs) and exceptions raised by the reporting platforms and/or Trade Repository across EU and UK regimes.
   

  

 Identify root causes (data quality, mapping, reference data, timing) and apply the appropriate corrective actions.
   

  

 Make the necessary amendments and resubmit corrected reports within the regulatory timeframe applicable in each jurisdiction.
   

  

 Maintain a clear audit trail of remediation activities for compliance and oversight review.
   

  

* DAILY AND MONTHLY RECONCILIATION


 Perform daily reconciliation on SFTR, MIFID, across EU and UK scopes to identify missing, incorrect or duplicated reports, investigate breaks, and implement remediation actions to resolve reconciliation breaks.
   

  

 For EMIR EU and UK scopes, and ASIC, reconcile the internal data against 3rd party SP reported output as part of the oversight function.
   

  

 Execute monthly reconciliations to validate the consistency between source data, and data submitted.
   

  

 Document reconciliation results and escalate unresolved breaks to the Regulatory Transactions Reporting team with proposed resolution actions and timeline.
   

  

* OVERSIGHT OF DELEGATED EMIR REPORTING ON ETD SCOPE PERFORMED BY CLEARING BROKERS


 Validate completeness, accuracy and timeliness of reports submitted by clearing brokers.
   

  

 Engage directly with clearing brokers to investigate discrepancies, request amendments and ensure corrections are made within the regulatory timeframe.
   

  

 Track and escalate persistent issues or recurring reporting failures to RTR team.
   

  

 Maintain documented evidence of the oversight performed, supporting RTR oversight and internal/external audit requirements.
   

  

* PAIRING AND MATCHING


 Investigate and resolve unpaired or unmatched transactions across EU and UK regimes, engaging directly with counterparties where required.
   

  

 Manage UTIs processing in line with internal procedures.
   

  

 Monitor and secure pairing and matching rates as a key indicator of reporting quality.
   

  

* REPORTING TO RTR TEAM


 Prepare and share daily statistics and dashboards for all jurisdictions (EU and UK for EMIR/MIFID/SFTR and ASIC) covering reported volumes, pairing and matching rates, accepted volumes, rejection rates and remediated volumes.
   

  

 Highlight emerging/faced issues, trends or risks to the RTR team in a timely and structured manner.
   

  

* CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT AND KNOWLEDGE SHARING


 Identify ad escalate recurring issues.
   

  

 Maintain up\-to\-date procedures, runbooks and knowledge base for all four regulatory regimes.
   

  

 Cross\-train and support fellow team members to maintain full interchangeability across the team.
   

  

 Stay updated with regulatory requirements changes and contribute to impact assessments when changes are announced.
   

  

**Specific Qualifications**
* MANDATORY:


 Minimum 2–3 years’ experience in regulatory transaction reporting within the financial services industry (asset management, sell\-side).
   

  

 Solid understanding of regulatory reporting mechanics: report submission lifecycles, ACK/NACK handling, UTI mechanics, pairing and matching, lifecycle events and action types.
   

  

 Strong working knowledge of at least one of EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II or ASIC Rewrite and the ability/willingness to acquire expertise across all four.
   

  

 Demonstrated ability to monitor and challenge an outsourced reporting provider, including reviewing their controls, reconciliations and SLA performance.
   

  

 Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, conditional logic) for reconciliation and reporting purposes.
   

  

* NICE TO HAVE:


 Working knowledge of 2 regulatory regimes or more (EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC Rewrite).
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with platforms such as: Aladdin, TRAX (ARM/APA), Tri\-Optima, DTCC, IHS Markit.
   

  

**Required Skills**
 Versatility and ability to switch between regimes and reporting flows depending on workload.
   

  

 Strong analytical and investigative skills, with ability to perform root\-cause analysis on data quality issues.
   

  

 Capability to translate reporting issues into clear messages for the RTR team and management.
   

  

 Capability to produce presentations and KPIs representative of reporting quality and activities in scope.
   

  

 Ability to support colleagues to achieve interchangeability, through documentation, knowledge sharing and active collaboration.
   

  

**Behavioral Skills**
* Active Listening
* Adaptability
* Ability to share/pass on knowledge
* Attention to detail

description:

 This hybrid role focuses on designing and optimizing SAP Integrated Business Planning solutions for supply chain operations in consumer goods. The role spans 6 to 10 years of experience and supports global day shift delivery without travel.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive end to end SAP IBP design across Demand Supply Inventory S and OP and Control Tower to enable resilient and agile planning processes that directly support consumer goods supply chains
* Translate complex business requirements in supply chain management into integrated SAP IBP functional designs that improve forecast accuracy service levels and working capital outcomes
* Configure SAP IBP Demand and related demand planning processes to support statistical forecasting demand sensing and promotion planning tailored to consumer goods business scenarios
* Optimize SAP IBP Supply and Time Series Optimiser models to balance capacity constraints and service levels while minimizing cost and improving on time performance
* Implement SAP IBP Inventory planning strategies to reduce excess stock mitigate obsolescence risk and improve product availability across distribution networks in consumer goods environments
* Set up and refine SAP IBP S and OP cycles that align demand supply and financial plans enabling data driven decision making and improved consensus planning outcomes
* Design and maintain SAP IBP Control Tower scenarios and alerts to provide near real time visibility into supply chain exceptions and to orchestrate timely corrective actions
* Configure and support CPI DS integrations to ensure reliable and timely data flows between SAP IBP and source systems strengthening planning data quality and consistency
* Collaborate with cross functional stakeholders in supply chain finance sales and manufacturing to validate planning designs and ensure solutions meet operational and strategic objectives
* Conduct business workshops requirement gathering sessions and system demonstrations to guide stakeholders through best practices in integrated business planning for consumer goods
* Develop detailed functional specifications test scenarios and user acceptance criteria to ensure robust solution delivery and smooth adoption by planning and operations teams
* Provide ongoing application support issue resolution and continuous improvement enhancements for SAP IBP modules to keep planning capabilities aligned with evolving business needs
* Mentor junior practitioners on SAP IBP processes configuration practices and supply chain concepts so that the project team can deliver consistent and scalable outcomes
* Drive adoption of hybrid working practices by planning and conducting remote and on site workshops training sessions and support activities aligned to day shift operations without travel requirements


**Qualifications**
* Possess professional experience of six to ten years in supply chain management with a strong focus on consumer goods demand planning supply planning and inventory optimization
* Demonstrate hands on implementation and support experience in SAP IBP Demand SAP IBP Supply and Time Series Optimiser SAP IBP Inventory SAP IBP S and OP and SAP IBP Control Tower across multiple projects
* Apply practical knowledge of CPI DS integration scenarios for SAP IBP including data extraction transformation data quality checks and monitoring of planning relevant data flows
* Bring solid understanding of core supply chain processes including demand planning supply planning distribution planning and sales and operations planning in consumer goods organizations
* Show proven ability to analyze large sets of planning data interpret key performance indicators and translate analytical insights into process improvements and SAP IBP configuration changes
* Exhibit strong communication and workshop facilitation capabilities in hybrid work models so that diverse stakeholder groups can align on planning designs and solution decisions
* Demonstrate familiarity with project delivery methodologies documentation standards and testing practices to ensure reliable and sustainable SAP IBP solution deployments


**Certifications Required**
 SAP Certified Application Associate in SAP Integrated Business Planning or equivalent SAP IBP certification preferred

description:

 Contract Type: Permanent
   

  

 Location(s):
   

  

 Chennai, IN
   

  

**Senior Engineer, Technical Operations**
**Your role in helping us shape the future:**
 As a
 **Sr. Engineer, Technical Operations,** 
 you will be an initial point of contact for software deployments, production issues (Software) related to SES Infight’s core services such as In\-Flight Connectivity (IFC)/In\-Flight Entertainment (IFE)/IPTV on retrofit and next generation Onboard Experience (OX) architectures and Satellite network performance. You will have desire to gain thorough technical knowledge on end\-to\-end system for providing quick analysis and driving resolution on production issues. In addition, you will be creating various dashboards and status reports for executives and end customers. You will be expected to build strong system/network level technical knowledge and use critical thinking to resolve issues faster.
   

  

 Additional responsibilities include but not limited to engage in PI (Agile teams) to understand the roadmap of upcoming features and services, lead the strategic oversight of platform and network performance, ensuring optimal performance, high reliability, and exceptional end\-user experience, lab setup for reproducing field issues and writing automation scripts for generating reports.
   

  

**Are you up to the challenge?**
* Desire to learn and champion new technologies and overall end\-to\-end system
* Develop a strong background in SES Infight’s technology platforms (ESA, KU, 2KU, ATG, ATG4 and autonomous IFE/IPTV) as well as third party technologies
* Understanding complex systems and able to diagnose and isolate the failures to a product/component level
* Deploying software to aircraft and monitor deployment performance
* Generate reports by fleet, technology, or airlines to assess the defect impact
* Triage software defect via strong analysis techniques (log/data analysis, defect tracking, etc.). Determine and document initial root cause, impact, severity, and frequency of failures
* Drive Internal Review Board (IRB) meetings with cross functional teams to agree and provide visibility on initial failure and impact
* Enforce and drive continuous improvements on Software Production Incidents process
* Participate in corrective action reports and root cause analysis exercises (e.g., fish bone, 8D, 5 Why’s, etc.)
* Generate test plans for reproducing field issues in lab environment
* Create reports for complex/critical production issues for senior management
* Define, develop and improve production diagnostics tools and defect analysis tools for quick turn around
* Support returned box analysis from production
* Support the field operation team by troubleshooting/triaging SW issues by following the defect management process (SPI/IRB), while being a strong voice for process adherence.
* Lead the resolution of network performance issues through strategic coordination across internal teams and provide expert technical support for airline performance and customer escalations to SES’s customer\-facing teams.
* Independently educate and manage internal and external stakeholders on performance metrics such as Latency, Speed, Packet Loss, Jitter, and the utilization of managed service fabric. Provide strategic guidance to ensure stakeholders have a clear understanding and alignment with organizational objectives.
* Lead comprehensive reviews and analyses of existing data collection systems. Provide strategic recommendations on improvements, maintenance, or other factors to significantly enhance system performance, reliability, and efficiency.
* Occasional travel to support new install/maintenance activities
* Ability to work at IST overnight \-\- till 3pm US Chicago time
* Rotation of shift every quarter to half year


**You should have:**
* System thinking skills for isolating issues within a complex network
* BS degree in Engineering/Computer Science disciplines
* 10\+ years of system level troubleshooting experience working on complex systems
* 5 years of relevant experience in the satellite and/or telecommunications industry
* TCP/IP, Linux/Shell Scripting, Packet Capture/WireShark, Jira, Wiki, Test Director
* JQL, SQL, Python, Java, Go, Git, Jenkins (CI), Spinnaker (CD), AWS OpenSearch
* Tableau, Power BI, Network Analysis
* Excellent Verbal/written communication skills
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Strong understanding of capacity and time management
* Flexibility to work occasional weekends or off hours, as emergencies arise
* Proactively seek continuous learning and continuous improvements
* Mentor new members and create personal development goals


**It would be nice if you had:**
* Strong networking background with CCNA/CCNE certifications
* Working knowledge of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe PI), DevOps and SRE
* Exceptional techno\-commercial business acumen in satellite communication network rollout, influencing strategic decisions and project success.

description:
**Project Role :** 
 Data Architect

**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 AI Powered Tech Talent
   

  

**Role Summary / Description**
 Engineer role in Knowledge Engineering for a strong individual contributor who helps build scalable Knowledge Graph, semantic layer, ontology, and AI\-enabled data solutions using Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, the successful candidate works hands\-on across the knowledge graph lifecycle from ingestion through modeling, curation, implementation, integration, and deployment. The role applies current methodologies, generative AI, LLM, multimodal, graph, search, and semantic techniques to practical business problems while collaborating with users, use case representatives, engineers, architects, UI designers, and delivery teams. The role must include industry experience or project exposure in domains such as banking, insurance, healthcare, retail, telecom, manufacturing, energy, public sector, or life sciences.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Build AWS\-based knowledge engineering components using Amazon Neptune, S3, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, OpenSearch, SageMaker, Bedrock, IAM, CloudWatch, APIs, and other relevant AWS services.
   

  

 Implement graph ingestion, ontology/schema pipelines, semantic data products, vector and search integrations, LLM grounding layers, and governed access patterns on AWS.
   

  

 Build Knowledge Graph components that contribute to transforming a client's data architecture.
   

  

 Design, develop, configure, test, and implement AI and semantic solutions that integrate clearly with the broader enterprise system.
   

  

 Work alongside project teams, delivery leads, engineers, architects, users, use case representatives, and UI designers to deliver assigned components of an end\-to\-end solution.
   

  

 Build solid working relationships with client counterparts on the workstream and communicate implementation progress, risks, dependencies, and technical findings clearly.
   

  

 Help assemble supporting evidence for recommended semantic layer solutions, including design rationale, implementation notes, validation inputs, data quality observations, and test outcomes.
   

  

 Support sales, solutioning, demos, accelerators, or reusable assets when called upon by providing technical inputs or implementation examples.
   

  

 Design, evaluate, maintain, and deploy ontologies, schemas, mappings, graph data models, metadata structures, validation rules, and knowledge graph components as needed.
   

  

 Keep developing skills in cutting\-edge Data and AI solutions, especially agentic technologies, generative AI, LLMs, multimodal models, semantic search, graph RAG, and knowledge graph approaches.
   

  

 Share learnings with the team and help junior engineers understand practical development patterns, engineering standards, and knowledge graph implementation practices.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field.
   

  

 Minimum 2 years of experience with Knowledge Graph technologies such as RDF, SPARQL, LPG, SHACL, OWL, graph query languages, schema design, ontology management, and KG curation.
   

  

 Minimum 2 years of experience in schema design, ontology management, semantic modeling, taxonomy management, metadata management, and knowledge graph curation.
   

  

 Minimum 2 years designing and developing Knowledge Graph solutions and graph\-based ML models across functional and technical contexts.
   

  

 Minimum 1 year of experience with end\-to\-end data pipeline implementation for AI applications, especially LLM\-enabled or enterprise knowledge applications, with hands\-on design and configuration.
   

  

 Minimum 2 years of experience with relational databases, object stores, graph databases such as Stardog, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune or equivalent, and vector databases.
   

  

 This role does not require leadership or commercial ownership team lead exposure is good to have.
   

  

 Ability to work hands\-on as a strong individual contributor while collaborating across project teams and delivery workstreams.
   

  

**Required Skills/ Experience**
 Hands\-on experience building AWS\-enabled knowledge engineering solutions with Amazon Neptune, S3, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, OpenSearch, SageMaker, Bedrock, IAM, CloudWatch, APIs, and cloud\-native data/AI services.
   

  

 2\+ years of Python experience with frameworks and tools such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, PySpark, SQL, SPARQL, SHACL, Apache Airflow, Apache NiFi, APIs, and ETL pipeline development.
   

  

 Practical experience with NLP and/or search techniques, prompt engineering, LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector search, semantic search, and enterprise\-scale AI application patterns.
   

  

 Ability to formulate real\-world problems into practical, efficient, and scalable AI and Knowledge Graph solution components.
   

  

 Industry experience applying AWS\-enabled knowledge engineering solutions in banking, insurance, healthcare, retail, communications, manufacturing, energy, public services, life sciences, or another relevant domain.
   

  

 Ability to build AWS\-based components for semantic layer, ontology, graph, vector search, search, retrieval, and LLM grounding use cases.
   

  

 Good to Have Skills
   

  

 2\+ years of hands\-on experience with cloud platforms, with AWS specialization and exposure to Azure or GCP in multi\-cloud environments.
   

  

 AWS certification or hands\-on project experience in AWS data, AI/ML, solution architecture, or cloud engineering.
   

  

 Team lead exposure or readiness to guide junior engineers on project tasks.
   

  

 External client\-facing consulting experience, including working with client stakeholders, delivery teams, or solutioning teams.
   

  

 Broad experience in diverse ML techniques, graph RAG, agentic systems, semantic search, entity resolution, multimodal models, explainable AI, and responsible AI practices.
   

  

 Experience building reusable code components, implementation templates, design notes, demos, proof\-of\-concept assets, runbooks, or enablement material.

description:
**Job Description**
**Job Profile Summary:** 
 The India Growth Analytics Lead is part of the broader India Insights \& Analytics (I\&A) Team which also includes Category Insights and Shopper Insights Managers. The key purpose of this position is to lead a India Growth Analytics sub\-team who will provide Prescriptive Analytics that drive agile fact\-based decisions and business growth in India. Specifically, this position is expected to establish, strengthen and advance key Analytics pillars namely: Marketing\-Media Analytics, Pricing \& Strategic Analytics, First party data analytics, Social listening and Business Intelligence. This position requires the right balance of analytics skills and business acumen and strong ability to communicate and partner with other functions, along with strong leadership qualities. This role will require close collaboration with other functions: Category Insights, Shopper Insights Managers, Marketing, Media, Finance, Category Planning \& Activation \& RGM (Sales).
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
**Business Optimization :** 
 Promotes the use of advanced modelling and analytics in order to improve the return on marketing investments and to develop fact\-based plans for the key Brands Generates and communicates the learning on application of analytics to business issues and is responsible for the identification of general principles that guide the investment of marketing \& trade spend and pricing strategies Leverages the analytic tools in conjunction with the BU portfolio to inform opportunities on the distortion of resources across Categories/Brands Provides consolidated reporting for in\-market performance and forecasts.
   

  

**Market Mix Modeling (MMM)** 
**/ Planning \& ROI** 
 Independently manage multiple Marketing Mix Modeling projects which are identified as key priorities in the India BU Prepare \& present regular ROI analyses, with actionable insights and opportunities, to relevant BU stakeholders Collaborate with Media Team, in Portfolio Advertising Spend optimization and distortion analysis based on MMM learnings across categories in India and potentially support Global Growth Analytics for any broader advertising optimization exercise.
   

  

**A\&C/Trade ROI Measurement:** 
 Continuity, Consistency \& Comparability Ensure Good ‘Science’, advanced statistical, calibrated Econometric Modeling Harmonized key metrics, definitions, inputs to enable “apples to apples” comparison across brands, markets on ROI’s, drivers of growth Cover business/brand drivers holistically ensuring sufficient granularity (especially Media mix, Price \& Promo, NPDs)
   

  

**Pricing Analytics**
* Independently manage multiple Pricing Research or Price Pack Architecture Analyses based on identified priorities and needs in the India BU.
* Utilize core PPA tools such as Mekko Charts, Threshold and Quartile analyses and run Pricing Simulators to flesh out and measure key PPA opportunities in India.


**Category Forecasting**
* Forecast category growth for next 1\-4 yrs leveraging the current best model/framework.
* Working with cross\-functional team to align and understand the trends and assumptions and then integrate category forecast in Annual Plan and Strategic Plan.
* Validate the category growth forecast and identify opportunities to better recalibrate current models.


**Continuous Improvement \& Innovation in New age analytics**
* Develop category knowledge, ROI, Media optimization learnings from MMM and Portfolio optimization opportunities and enhance inputs to Brand Drivers modeling, ROI measurement \& Optimization capability
* Continuous process improvement to reduce cycle time \& costs across all elements of the MMM process – esp. data collection, modeling
* Understands and is able to drive social listening skill set within the team and use social listening tools to analyze and share inputs for the growth agenda of the BU.
* Is able to forecast new product volumes accurately.


**People Management**
* Leads the development of a strong Growth Analytics sub\-team in India that can provide the right insights and analytics to drive growth
* Conducts annual / mid\-year appraisals with direct reports and ensures that personal development plans are in place for all team members
* Mentors the team


**Communication:** 
 Communicate all learning and insights in a compelling way to drive action: Ensure presentations and reports are clear, timely and inspiring as well as actionable. Influence BU Teams. Build management confidence in recommended actions with appropriate interpretation and integration of key concepts.
   

  

**Workshop \& Activation:** 
 Set up detailed agenda, invite key stakeholders, arrange other logistics related to a debrief workshop to share and align on the learnings, recommendations which should be considered for short term (Annual Business Plans) and long term (Strategic 3\-year Plans).
   

  

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**
* Min 15\+ years working experience in marketing research, Advanced Analytics preferably at a CPG or FMCG company and 7 years in MMM \& forecasting/business planning in increasing responsibility positions.
* Min. Bachelor’s Degree (Social Science, Business Administration, Marketing, Statistics, Economics, required)
* MBA or MA in Social Science with concentration in research, marketing, quantitative analysis is required. PhD is a plus.
* High analytical skills and wisdom/judgement to evaluate and improve delivery
* Strong knowledge of advanced analytics methods (Marketing Mix Econometric modeling, Forecasting Simulators, Price Pack Architecture / Pricing, Dashboarding, Innovation Incrementality. etc.)
* Able to synthesize data from different sources into a well\-structured story with clear implications
* Has very good understanding of Pricing concepts – Price elasticity, demand \& supply theory, role of pricing in relation to other marketing mix sales drivers
* Good interpersonal, intercultural and communication / influence skills
* Worked with Market research data sources (Retail Measurement, Brand Health Trackers and Consumer \& Shopper panels, Euromonitor, assessment of data quality)
* Effective management skills to develop team and lead/contribute to project management of custom projects.
* Competent in all standard PC packages including Excel, Word, PowerPoint
* Experience in using Nielsen Retail Audit database software (Answers, Nielsen Insight Studio) to extract data, prepare reports \& dashboards
* Strong knowledge, capability \& experience in Household Consumer Panel, Euromonitor \& Media Databases
* Experience in working with advanced statistics


**More About This Role**

Specific skills also include Superior written and verbal communication skills. A strong storyteller, a lucid and structured communicator, who makes their point clearly and persuasively.
   

  

* Must be able to handle numerous projects at one time and meet fast turnaround deadlines
* Advanced organizational skills

* Prior knowledge and experience of the Mondelēz International organization is preferred but not a requirement.
* Persuasive and stimulating ‘packaging’ and presentation of all materials is a significant part of the job, as is explaining/arguing/defending/developing the thinking in all meetings and communication scenarios.
* Balancing the ability to deliver with urgency with the ability of keeping momentum due to the reality that building capabilities is more of a marathon than a sprint

* Become a respected internal source of knowledge on best practices

description:
Project Engineer – Digital Commerce
 



 Company: Arizon Digital USA – Digital Commerce Experts
 



 Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time \| On\-site
 



  





  





  





 About Arizon Digital
 



 Arizon Digital USA is a digital commerce solutions company helping businesses design, build, integrate, and optimize high\-performing eCommerce platforms.
 



  





 Since 2016, we have delivered digital commerce solutions across B2B eCommerce, retail, digital products, headless commerce, Store of the Future, mobile solutions, integrations, and custom applications.
 



  





 Our technology ecosystem includes platforms such as BigCommerce, Shopify, Magento, AWS, and WP Engine, combined with modern web technologies, APIs, integrations, and cloud services.
 



  





 We are looking for a Project Engineer who can operate at the intersection of business, processes, and technology and help turn business requirements into practical, scalable digital solutions.
 



  





  





  





 About the Role
 



 As a Project Engineer, you will work closely with business stakeholders, project managers, product owners, designers, and engineering teams to understand business objectives, analyze existing processes, define requirements, and translate them into technical solutions.
 



  





 This is a hybrid business \+ process \+ technology role.
 



  





 You will not be expected to be a pure software developer. Instead, you should be comfortable understanding how systems work, asking the right technical questions, working with APIs and integrations, analyzing data, understanding eCommerce platforms, and collaborating with developers to ensure that the right solution is delivered.
 



  





 You will play an important role throughout the project lifecycle—from discovery and requirements through solution design, development, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement.
 



  





  





  





 Key Responsibilities Business \& Requirements Analysis
 



 Understand business objectives, customer journeys, operational challenges, and system requirements.
 



 Work with stakeholders to gather, clarify, and document functional and non\-functional requirements.
 



 Convert business requirements into clear user stories, use cases, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications.
 



 Identify gaps, dependencies, assumptions, and potential risks early in the project.
 



 Challenge requirements constructively and identify opportunities to simplify or improve business processes.
 



 Process Analysis \& Optimization
 



  





 Analyze existing business and operational processes and identify inefficiencies.
 



 Create process flows, workflows, system flows, and functional diagrams.
 



 Identify opportunities for automation, optimization, and digital transformation.
 



 Understand how business processes translate into system functionality.
 



 Evaluate the impact of proposed technology changes across users, processes, data, and integrations.
 



 Technical Analysis
 



  





 Work closely with developers and architects to translate requirements into technical solutions.
 



 Develop a good understanding of web applications, eCommerce platforms, APIs, databases, integrations, and cloud environments.
 



 Analyze API documentation and understand request/response structures, authentication, data mapping, and integration flows.
 



 Understand data models, product/catalog structures, customer/order data, and system\-to\-system data flows.
 



 Participate in technical discussions and help identify practical implementation approaches.
 



 Review technical designs and provide business/process context to engineering teams.
 



 Identify technical dependencies and communicate their business impact to stakeholders.
 



 Digital Commerce
 



  





 Develop a strong understanding of eCommerce concepts such as:
 



 Product catalogs and variants
 



 Pricing and promotions
 



 Customer accounts
 



 B2B workflows
 



 Cart and checkout
 



 Payments
 



 Order management
 



 Inventory
 



 Shipping
 



 Search and merchandising
 



 Content management
 



 Customer journeys
 



 Work with platforms such as Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, or similar commerce platforms.
 



 Understand how third\-party systems integrate with commerce platforms.
 



 Data \& Integration
 



  





 Analyze business and technical data to identify issues, patterns, and opportunities.
 



 Work with SQL or similar tools to investigate data and validate business scenarios.
 



 Support data migration and transformation activities.
 



 Define data mappings between systems.
 



 Analyze integration failures and work with engineering teams to identify root causes.
 



 Support API and integration testing.
 



 Testing \& Delivery
 



  





 Create test scenarios and acceptance criteria based on business requirements.
 



 Support QA teams during functional and integration testing.
 



 Coordinate and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
 



 Analyze defects, determine business impact, and help prioritize fixes.
 



 Validate that delivered solutions meet the original business requirements.
 



 Support deployment, release validation, and post\-production analysis.
 



 Project Collaboration
 



  





 Work closely with Project Managers, Product Owners, Developers, QA Engineers, Designers, and client stakeholders.
 



 Participate in sprint planning, refinement, demos, retrospectives, and project discussions.
 



 Track requirements, dependencies, risks, issues, and decisions.
 



 Communicate complex technical concepts in a way that business stakeholders can understand.
 



 Communicate business requirements clearly enough for technical teams to implement.
 



 Maintain accurate project and technical documentation.
 



 What We're Looking For
 



  





 We are looking for someone who is curious about both business and technology.
 



  





 You should be someone who can look at a business problem and naturally ask:
 



  





 "Why does this process exist?" → "How should it work?" → "How will the system support it?" → "How do we build and validate it?"
 



  





  





  





 Required Skills
 



 Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
 



 Strong understanding of business processes and requirements analysis.
 



 Ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications.
 



 Good understanding of web technologies and software application architecture.
 



 Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication, and system integrations.
 



 Basic\-to\-intermediate SQL and data analysis skills.
 



 Understanding of databases and data structures.
 



 Ability to create process flows, system flows, use cases, and functional specifications.
 



 Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC).
 



 Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
 



 Strong communication and documentation skills.
 



 Ability to work effectively with both business and technical teams.
 



  





 Good to Have
 



 Experience with Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, WooCommerce, or other eCommerce platforms.
 



 Experience with B2B eCommerce.
 



 Experience working with APIs and third\-party integrations.
 



 Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS.
 



 Knowledge of Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js, or similar technologies.
 



 Experience with Postman or similar API testing tools.
 



 Experience with SQL databases.
 



 Understanding of headless commerce and composable commerce architectures.
 



 Experience with data migration and system integrations.
 



 Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, GitHub, or similar project collaboration tools.
 



 Education \& Experience
 



  





 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
 



 Typically 2–5 years of experience in Business Analysis, Systems Analysis, Software Engineering, eCommerce implementation, Technical Consulting, or a similar role.
 



 Candidates with strong technical fundamentals and an interest in business/process analysis are encouraged to apply.
 



 What Success Looks Like
 



  





 A successful Project Engineer at Arizon Digital will be able to:
 



  





 Understand a client's business problem without needing every detail explained.
 



 Break complex requirements into manageable functional and technical components.
 



 Map the business process → system process → data flow → technical implementation.
 



 Speak confidently with both business stakeholders and developers.
 



 Identify gaps and edge cases before development begins.
 



 Use data and technical investigation to solve problems rather than relying on assumptions.
 



 Understand enough technology to challenge solutions and make informed decisions.
 



 Ensure that what is built actually solves the original business problem.
 



 Continuously look for opportunities to improve the product, process, architecture, and customer experience.
 



 Why Join Arizon Digital?
 



  





 Work on real\-world digital commerce transformation projects.
 



 Gain exposure to multiple commerce platforms and technology ecosystems.
 



 Work across business, product, technology, integrations, and cloud.
 



 Learn how enterprise eCommerce platforms are designed, implemented, integrated, and scaled.
 



 Work directly with experienced technology and project teams.
 



 Opportunity to grow toward Technical Business Analyst, Solution Consultant, Product Owner, Solution Architect, or Engineering leadership roles.
 



 If you enjoy solving business problems through technology and want to work across both the functional and technical sides of digital commerce, we'd love to hear from you.
