title: Risk Analytics - Product Analyst - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS \- Delivery Excellence Senior position**
 Within last decade, cost of delivery and Delivery excellence has become the most critical factors to run successful and popular businesses spread around the globe. To support such a dynamic and fast paced IT transformation industry, we are using various cutting\-edge Delivery Excellence models and tools with relentless focus on automation to offer best in class and tailor\-made solutions to our clients.
   

  

 As a part of our global team you will be part of GDS projects as Delivery Excellence management professional. You will be involved in working on challenging problems and creating next generation delivery excellence platforms.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Are you a detail‑driven professional with a passion for translating business needs into impactful product experiences? Do you thrive at the intersection of people, process, and technology? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join our Product team and help shape solutions that deliver real value to our clients and users.
   

  

 In this role, you’ll serve as a critical bridge between the business stakeholders and the development and engineering teams. Your work will influence how ideas become features, how features become products, and how products deliver meaningful outcomes in a fast‑paced, evolving environment.
   

  

 As a key member of the Product team, you will play a hands‑on role in defining business requirements, crafting user stories, and ensuring that technical execution aligns seamlessly with business objectives. You will lead user acceptance testing (UAT), drive iterative testing cycles, validate enhancements, and ensure that issues or defects are accurately identified, tracked, and resolved. Your keen eye for detail and strong communication skills will help ensure that every release meets the highest standards of quality and functionality.
   

  

 This is a client‑facing and user‑centric role where you will engage with stakeholders, address queries, clarify requirements, and ensure that feedback is incorporated into continuous product improvements. You’ll gain a deep understanding of real‑world user behaviors, business processes, and product journeys—making this the perfect place to grow as a product‑focused business professional while driving meaningful impact across the product lifecycle.
   

  

 If you’re energized by the opportunity to influence product development end‑to‑end, collaborate with cross‑functional teams, and help bring scalable, user‑friendly solutions to life, this role provides the platform for you to make a lasting difference.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements, ensuring alignment across stakeholders, product managers, and engineering teams.
* Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by testing the defined test cases, validating functionality, and ensuring readiness for release.
* Supervise in iterative testing cycles, identifying defects, documenting issues, validating fixes, and performing regression testing as needed.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
* Serve as one of the primary liason between business teams and engineering, providing clarifications, resolving requirement gaps, and ensuring shared understanding throughout the product lifecycle.
* Review and validate bug fixes, ensuring that resolved issues meet expected outcomes before closure.
* Engage with clients and end‑users, addressing queries, troubleshooting issues, and gathering feedback for continuous improvement.
* Support product rollout activities, including release planning, communication, and training support where required.
* Monitor product performance post‑release, identify enhancement opportunities, and contribute to backlog prioritization.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation including requirement specifications, UAT plans, test results, and user feedback logs.
* Lead product strategy, roadmap planning, and end\-to\-end product lifecycle management for Internal Controls and Audit solutions.
* Partner with stakeholders across business, risk, audit, and technology teams to gather requirements and drive product adoption.
* Own MIS, reporting, KPI tracking, and executive dashboards to measure product performance and business outcomes.
* Analyse large datasets to derive insights, identify control gaps, and support decision\-making.
* Drive product implementation, rollout, user onboarding, and change management initiatives.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to define functional requirements and prioritise product backlogs.
* Identify automation and AI opportunities to enhance audit and internal control processes.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Risk Assessment – Assessment of internal processes to identify findings, vulnerabilities, and control gaps/deviations identified across applications and infrastructure.
* Control Monitoring / Testing \- Understanding of controls around Business processes, ITGC, Cyber, Data protection and privacy to perform testing of design and operational effectiveness of controls.
* Agentic AI architecture\- Design agentic AI system architectures and define associated technical guardrails.
* Control Automation – Identify automation opportunities using analytics platform to monitor the operational effectiveness on the regular basis.
* Functional understanding of foundation models (LLMs) and associated risks. Awareness of the AI deployment lifecycle
* Strong business\-side understanding of Risk domains relevant to building, deploying, and scaling AI‑enabled Risk products (e.g., Financial Risk, Regulatory \& Compliance, Internal Controls, Fraud, Enterprise Risk).
* Ability to translate business risk problems into product requirements and work closely with technology, data and engineering teams.
* Experience in Presales, Sales Enablement, Tech Sales, or Solution Consulting for Risk, Finance, or AI/Analytics offerings.
* Ability to support client conversations, proposal development, solution positioning, and value articulation for Risk products.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with business delivery teams.
* Analytical thinking.
* Well organized, attentive to details attitude.
* Open to hiring across locations, aligned with EY’s Global Delivery Services (GDS) model.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Overall 7\-9 years of experience in Risk Advisory (preferably Internal Controls) experience with Big 4 or comparable professional services environment
* CA or Master’s degree in business administration or Risk Management
* Good to have certifications – CISA, CISM, CIA, AIGP, ISO 42001, CISSP, CRISC, CCSK, ISO 27001, and others (as relevant)
* Any 1 hard tech skill is a must – Either Python or Databricks Or full stack or AI
* Product Management experience with demonstrated ownership of delivering business solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Experience in reporting, MIS, analytics, and data\-driven decision making.
* Hands\-on experience in product implementation and deployment.
* Domain expertise in Internal Controls, Risk, Compliance, or Audit (mandatory).


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 250\+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing...**
 At Verizon, we aren't just building a world\-class Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A) organization—we are fundamentally redefining the future of finance. As we step into the AI era, we are pioneering intelligent, AI\-driven FP\&A practices that will completely transform how finance teams operate and deliver strategic value. Through a comprehensive initiative to streamline processes, modernize our systems, and invest heavily in the continuous growth of our people, we are setting the industry standard. This is your opportunity to be the catalyst for this AI\-powered revolution, helping us make Verizon the ultimate destination for forward\-thinking FP\&A professionals.
   

  

 Move Beyond Compiling Data And Help Tell The Story Behind The Numbers. The Corporate FP\&A Positions Offer Opportunities To Drive Better Business Partnering And Insights While Developing Your Skill Set And Leadership As We Continue To Grow As a World\-class Organization. You Are a Valuable Business Partner, Finding New And Better Ways Of Working By Leveraging Digital And AI Capabilities. You’ll Become Involved In Planning, Reporting, Analyses, And Initiatives That Will Impact Important Decisions Around The Growth And Development Of Verizon's Business. In Our Department, You Will
   

  

* Architect Intelligent Workflows: Identify bottlenecks in traditional FP\&A processes (like month\-end close or manual data consolidation) and spearhead the implementation of automations and AI solutions.
* AI\-Enhanced Data Storytelling: Transform complex, multi\-layered datasets into clear, actionable intelligence using advanced data visualization tools and AI\-generated insights.
* Bridge Finance and Technology: Act as the crucial link between traditional FP\&A and data science teams, ensuring AI algorithms are trained with deep financial context and commercial acumen
* Prompt Engineering for Finance: Utilize generative AI tools to rapidly synthesize financial data, draft preliminary variance narratives, and accelerate the reporting cycle.
* Ensure timely and accurate delivery of financial planning, reporting \& analyses for the business.
* Be a trusted advisor by providing valuable decision support and guidance to FP\&A Business Partners.
* Proactive Value Creation: Move beyond retrospective reporting to become a forward\-looking strategic advisor, using AI\-driven scenario planning to guide executive decision\-making and identify growth opportunities.
* Actively participate in the cultural and professional development of Corporate FP\&A as a world\-class organization through Mentor/Mentee relationships and various activities offered.
* Be the Impetus for Change: Champion the adoption of AI and modern finance practices across the broader Verizon team, overcoming resistance to change through education and proven results.


 As part of the Corporate FP\&A team, you will be helping the reporting and accounting teams deliver world\-class, zero\-touch automated solutions for all Verizon entities. You will interact with finance teams across the business, bringing new automated and AI\-driven solutions to life for our month\-end financial close and reporting activities.
   

  

**Reporting, Automation \& Data Visualization**
* Deliver best\-in\-class end\-to\-end automated solutions for our stakeholders to support Finance Business Units (BUs) and drive efficiencies.
* Design data visualizations of financial statements for different organizations across Verizon.
* Deliver C\-Suite Executive reporting with 100% quality and accuracy.
* Collaborate with the various stakeholders to deploy Qlik/ Looker Applications in production environments and resolve any production issues with existing applications.
* Document processes to ensure accuracy across the enterprise and maintain strict change control.


**AI \& Analytics Systems Architecture**
* Design and build AI solutions that interact with development tools, codebases, and team workflows in meaningful ways.
* Work extensively with LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini, Codex, and others) to understand their capabilities, limitations, and optimal application patterns for financial automation.
* Own the developer experience of agentic interactions—making complex AI capabilities feel natural and trustworthy for finance end\-users.
* Lead technical decision\-making on agent patterns, model selection, and integration approaches.


 What we’re looking for…
   

  

 You are a strong collaborator who can effectively own and prioritize multiple work streams and adapt during pressured situations. You display initiative and resourcefulness but are also comfortable brainstorming and sharing ideas in a team environment. You possess excellent communication skills and can partner effectively across multiple business and finance teams to speak to both internal and external stakeholders. You are adaptable to change, meet tight deadlines, and are strongly focused on the quality of your deliverables.
   

  

**You'll Need To Have**
* Bachelor’s degree and Four or more years of work experience in financial report automations.
* Five or more years of relevant work experience in Business Intelligence/Analytics within FP\&A teams (but not limited to this function).
* Hands on experience in Qlik Sense \& Tableau.
* Experience with Looker, LookML will be an added advantage
* Vizlib and NPrinting experience in Qlik Sense.
* Deep, hands\-on experience building AI agents or agentic systems in production.
* Strong understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations across multiple models (Claude, Gemini, Codex, etc.).
* Expertise in prompt engineering, model selection, and working with tool\-use/function calling.
* Ability to mine, extract, transform, and load large financial datasets to create zero\-touch reports.
* Working knowledge of report automation tools, technologies, and end\-to\-end ETL processes (e.g., Knime Analytics Platform, Alteryx).
* Experience with Qlik Sense and QVD generations from different data sources.
* Experience in Essbase, SQL, and SQL performance tuning.
* Knowledge of Google Suite, database management systems, and ticketing tools (e.g., Jira).


 Even better if you have one or more of the following:
   

  

* Familiarity with evaluation frameworks for agentic systems and understanding of the practical tradeoffs in production.
* Basic knowledge of programming languages essential for modern data and AI work (e.g., Python, Google App Scripting, React.js, etc.,).
* Background in developer tools, productivity platforms, or engineering analytics.
* Exposure to GCP Big Query and Teradata databases.
* A proven ability to derive insights from data and recommend actionable business strategies.


**Where you'll be working**
 In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
   

  

 Where you’ll be working

title: GeoSpatial Lead Analyst MAP
description:
**Job Summary**
 GeoSpatial Lead Analyst MAP is responsible for advanced geospatial data analysis and ( Growth loop (Preferred) ) modeling to support critical engineering decisions with a primary focus on crack propagation and growth assessment. The role involves hybrid work in a day shift setting applying specialized analytical methods to evaluate structural integrity risks optimize asset performance and drive data backed recommendations that enhance safety
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead complex geospatial analysis projects that integrate multi dimensional spatial datasets with crack propagation and growth models to evaluate structural integrity across large asset networks and critical infrastructure systems.
* Drive the design and refinement of crack propagation analytical frameworks by applying fracture mechanics principles to geospatially distributed assets enabling precise identification of high risk regions and prioritization of mitigation actions.
* Develop advanced geospatial data processing pipelines that clean transform and normalize spatial and temporal datasets ensuring accurate input parameters for crack growth simulations and engineering risk assessments.
* Oversee validation of crack growth predictions by comparing model outputs with field measurements inspection data and historical failure records to continuously improve model accuracy and reliability for operational decision making.
* Provide detailed geospatial risk maps and visualizations that overlay crack growth trajectories with asset locations environmental conditions and usage profiles enabling stakeholders to quickly understand vulnerability hot spots and plan interventions.
* Coordinate with engineering operations and safety teams to translate geospatial and crack propagation insights into practical maintenance schedules inspection plans and asset management strategies that reduce downtime and extend service life.
* Create comprehensive analytical reports and dashboards that summarize geospatial findings crack growth trends and scenario based simulations helping decision makers allocate resources efficiently and justify investments in preventive measures.
* Optimize data workflows for the hybrid work model by leveraging secure remote access tools version controlled repositories and standardized documentation practices to maintain continuity and transparency across onsite and remote collaboration.
* Support continuous improvement of geospatial and crack propagation methodologies by experimenting with new algorithms refining parameter estimation techniques and incorporating emerging industry best practices into the analytical toolkit.
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to define data quality standards for spatial and engineering datasets ensuring reliable ingestion storage and retrieval of information used in crack growth modeling and geospatial risk evaluations.
* Guide adoption of automation and scripting capabilities in geospatial analysis pipelines to reduce manual effort improve repeatability of crack propagation studies and accelerate delivery of insights to cross functional stakeholders.
* Champion the societal impact of robust geospatial and crack growth analytics by demonstrating how proactive asset integrity management enhances public safety protects the environment and supports sustainable infrastructure development.
* Manage day shift analytical activities to ensure timely completion of high priority assessments alignment with project milestones and effective communication of geospatial risk findings to relevant teams within the organization.


**Qualifications**
* Possess extensive experience in geospatial data analysis including spatial statistics raster and vector processing and map based visualization tailored to support engineering and infrastructure integrity decisions at scale.
* Demonstrate deep hands on expertise in crack propagation and crack growth modeling using fracture mechanics concepts numerical simulation tools and empirical calibration methods applied to real world structural components.
* Apply strong proficiency in programming or scripting for data analysis such as using languages or platforms that enable efficient processing of large geospatial datasets integration with crack growth models and automation of workflows.
* Utilize advanced skills in statistical modeling and uncertainty quantification to evaluate confidence levels in crack propagation predictions and to communicate probabilistic risk metrics to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Bring solid understanding of materials behavior stress analysis and structural health monitoring principles that inform the selection of input parameters and boundary conditions used in crack growth and geospatial risk simulations.
* Leverage experience with enterprise geospatial platforms and data management solutions to design scalable architectures for storing querying and visualizing spatial datasets relevant to asset integrity and crack progression studies.
* Exhibit strong communication and documentation capabilities to present complex geospatial and crack growth findings in clear narrative form including maps charts and written interpretations that support sound operational decisions.
* Maintain familiarity with industry standards and regulatory expectations related to structural integrity assessment crack evaluation techniques and geospatial reporting practices ensuring that analyses align with compliance requirements.
* Show proven ability to work effectively in a hybrid environment coordinating tasks across onsite and remote settings while maintaining secure data handling practices and consistent engagement with project stakeholders.

title: Assistant Manager – Revenue (Chennai)
description:
**About The Team**
 We are building a high\-performance Revenue \& Marketing pod — a geography\-focused business unit that owns end\-to\-end top\-line and bottom\-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
   

  

 This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data\-fluent, and thrive in a fast\-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Revenue \& P\&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P\&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course\-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth \& Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first\-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install\-not\-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in\-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on\-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end\-to\-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high\-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence \& Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in\-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data\-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health \& Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock\-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop\-offs — with revenue\-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics \& Reporting
* Maintain a real\-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions


**Who We Are Looking For**
 Must Have
   

  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution \[IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e\-commerce operations, or P\&L\-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross\-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast\-paced, high\-accountability environment


 Good to Have
   

  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e\-commerce, Q\-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on\-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in\-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell\-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on\-ground activation


**What We Offer**
* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P\&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High\-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

title: FS-RISK CONSULTING-FSRM - QBB-SENIOR
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Business Consulting QAS\- Quantitative Banking Book (QBB)**
**Profile: Senior Consultant**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 This role offers the opportunity to work within EY’s Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group, supporting leading global financial institutions in identifying, measuring, and managing risk including trading book market risk \& counterparty credit risk, banking book credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory requirements.
   

  

 As part of the Quantitative Banking Book (QBB) team within FSRM, you will contribute to strategic and functional transformation across risk management within the banking portfolio. You will apply quantitative skills to enhance risk estimation processes, support regulatory compliance, and develop analytics that drive better decision making for clients with lending activities. This is an opportunity for quant professionals looking to work on models, regulatory initiatives, and high impact capital markets engagements across banks, including large domestic and global financial institutions.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Demonstrate deep technical capabilities and industry knowledge of financial products, in particular lending products
* Understand market trends and demands in the financial services sector and issues faced by clients by staying abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the client's business
* Monitor progress, manage risk, and effectively communicate with key stakeholders regarding status, issues and key priorities to achieve expected outcomes
* Play an active role in mentoring junior consultants within the organization
* Required to review, analyse and concur with tasks completed by junior staff
* Flexibility to work across projects involving model audits, validation and development activities


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Complete, end\-to\-end understanding of credit risk model development or validation for the banking book portfolio (PD/LGD/EAD)
* Should have hands on experience in data preparation, manipulation and consolidation
* Expertise in Stress Testing models and/or PD/LGD/EAD models
* Solid grounding in statistics and econometrics, especially logistic regression, linear regression, fractional response, decision tree
* Strong documentation skills. Required to be adept in quickly grasping key details and summarizing them in a presentation or document
* Strong knowledge in regulatory modelling (ECB/PRA/HKMA/Regulators) with model development/validation experience
* Strong technical skills, highly proficient in Advanced Python (Pandas, Numpy, ScikitLearn, Object Oriented Programming, Parallel Processing), SAS (SAS Certified Preferred), SQL, R, excel
* Should be able to take initiative and work independently with minimal supervision, if required
* Awareness of emerging AI/ML methodologies and their use in risk management, model validation, and quantitative workflow automation (experience in AI/ML will be preferred)
* Basic AI knowledge, excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem solving skills


**Ideally, You Will Also Have**
* Good to have knowledge in Machine Learning models and its applications
* Advanced knowledge in AI is good to have.
* Previous project management experience


**What We Look For**
* Postgraduate (master’s in accounting, finance, economics, statistics or a related field) with at least 3 years of related work experience
* Regulatory knowledge in IFRS 9, IRB, CCAR, CECL, Stress Testing, DFAST
* Professional certifications (FRM, SCR, RAI, CFA, PRM are a plus)
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and support engagements with global financial institutions
* Willingness to travel based on client needs.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

 Location: Chennai South

 Experience: Freshers are welcome to apply
 



 Joining: Immediate
 



  





 Connected CRM Studio is looking for a smart, organised and technology\-focused Operations Assistant to support our Office Operations, HR and Accounts teams.
 



 This is not a traditional office administration position. It is a new\-age operations role in which the selected candidate will use advanced Excel, office productivity applications and AI tools to organise operational data, conduct research, prepare management reports and support data\-driven decision\-making.

* Maintain accurate office, employee and operational data.

* Prepare and maintain documents using Microsoft Word and other office productivity tools.

* Excellent written and spoken English communication.

* Good organisational and time\-management skills.

* Lives in or can comfortably commute to Chennai South.

* Wants to build a career combining operations, reporting, technology and AI.

description:
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a highly experienced and visionary leader to join our Data/Analytics/ Performance Management team. This critical role will be at the forefront of driving data\-led transformation, operational excellence, and strategic insights within our core banking operations. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of banking processes, coupled with exceptional analytical capabilities and a proven track record of implementing significant operational improvements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**The successful candidate will be responsible for:**
* Strategic Data Leadership: Lead the strategy and execution of data\-driven initiatives within operations, identifying opportunities for automation, efficiency gains, and enhanced decision\-making.
* Insights \& Analytics: Develop and implement robust analytical frameworks to extract meaningful insights from operational data. Translate complex data into actionable recommendations for senior management to optimize performance, reduce risk, and improve customer experience.
* Operational Excellence: Drive a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence across functions. Identify process bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and areas for automation, leading improvement projects from conception to completion.
* Transformation \& Change Management: Spearhead large\-scale transformation projects, leveraging data and technology to re\-engineer processes, implement new systems, and enhance overall efficiency. Lead change management efforts to ensure successful adoption of new methodologies and tools.

title: Integration Engineer – IICS & Boomi
description:
**Integration Engineer – IICS \& Boomi** 




  





**Full Time \| Chennai** 




  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are looking for an experienced Integration Engineer to join the data team on a strategic account with an enterprise manufacturing client, working alongside our Data Architect and the wider engineering, integration, and BI team. This is a permanent, full\-lifecycle role: you will design, build, maintain, and optimize integration services on the client's Boomi and IICS platforms, working within their established enterprise architecture and governance standards.
 



 A major current initiative is consolidating a legacy Talend estate into Boomi and IICS. You will help rebuild and rationalize those services onto the right target platform \- reliably, with proven output parity \- and contribute technical tool\-fit input to the assessment framework that decides the best target (Boomi vs IICS) for each service. But the role extends well beyond migration: as the estate consolidates, you own the ongoing health of the integration landscape \- new service design, enhancements, production support, and performance and cost optimization.
 



 The core skill is depth in the target platforms \- Boomi and IICS. Talend familiarity is a strong accelerator for the consolidation work, but not a prerequisite: you'll be reading Talend to understand intent, not building new Talend.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Design \& Build:** 




  





 · Design and implement integration services on Boomi and/or IICS, following the client's
 



 architecture standards and integration patterns.
 



 · Build integration flows, mappings, orchestrations, connectors, error handling, and scheduling.
 



 · Enhance and extend existing services as business needs evolve.
 



 · Own solution design decisions and communicate their trade\-offs to technical and business
 



 audiences.
 



  





**Migration \& Consolidation (current initiative):** 




 · Rebuild legacy Talend integration services on Boomi and/or IICS.
 



 · Reverse\-engineer existing Talend jobs to establish their true behavior \- business logic,
 



 transformations, edge cases, and data handling \- not just their surface intent.
 



 · Partner with the team's existing Talend knowledge holder to validate understanding of legacy
 



 services.
 



 · Define and run parity / reconciliation testing to prove each rebuilt service matches its legacy
 



 output; resolve source\-to\-target discrepancies.
 



 · Contribute technical tool\-fit input to the Boomi\-vs\-IICS assessment framework.
 



  





**Maintenance \& Optimization:** 




 · Provide ongoing production support for built integration services \- monitoring, troubleshooting,
 



 and resolving issues.
 



 · Optimize services for performance, reliability, and cost / consumption efficiency.
 



 · Perform root\-cause analysis and implement sustainable fixes.
 



 · Maintain a prioritized backlog of improvements and technical debt.
 



  





**Collaboration \& Delivery:** 




 · Work within the client's enterprise architecture, governance, and security standards.
 



 · Coordinate with the Data Architect, platform, security, and business teams.
 



 · Maintain clear documentation of services, designs, and support procedures.
 



  





**Required Skills and Experience:** 




 · Demonstrated depth as an integration / ETL engineer across the full lifecycle \- design, build,
 



 and ongoing maintenance (we are flexible on total years \- see note above).
 



 · Working knowledge of both Boomi and IICS, with genuine working knowledge of the other \- or
 



 a strong track record of ramping quickly onto an adjacent iPaaS platform.
 



 · Strong integration fundamentals: mappings, transformations, orchestration, connectors, APIs,
 



 error handling, and scheduling.
 



 · Experience maintaining and optimizing integration services in production \- performance,
 



 reliability, and cost / consumption.
 



 · Proven ability to reverse\-engineer undocumented or lightly\-documented integration jobs and
 



 rebuild them faithfully.
 



 · Discipline around validation \- reconciliation and parity testing to confirm rebuilt services match
 



 legacy behavior.
 



 · Strong SQL.
 



 · Comfortable working within, and delivering to, an established enterprise architecture and
 



 governance framework.
 



 · Clear communicator \- able to explain technical decisions to both technical and business
 



 audiences.
 



  





**Preferred Skills:** 




 · Talend experience \- even at a read / maintenance level \- to accelerate reverse\-engineering of
 



 the legacy estate.
 



 · Strength in both Boomi and IICS.
 



 · Experience with data platform migrations, consolidations, or replatforming.
 



 · Familiarity with Snowflake and AWS data / platform services (the client's data estate sits on this
 



 stack).
 



 · Data governance, security, and role\-based access concepts.
 



 · Experience delivering into a large, standards\-driven enterprise \- ideally in manufacturing or a
 



 comparable industrial / operational domain.
 



 · Familiarity with ITIL\-based incident, problem, and change\-management processes.
 



  





**Certifications (a plus \- hands\-on capability matters more):** 




 · Boomi certification (Associate / Professional Developer / Architect)
 



 · Informatica Cloud (IICS) certification

We are committed to investing in our diverse teams where everyone understands their role and how they support our strategic goals, we drive operational excellence through scale and efficiency, and we strive to delight our customers and become the market leader in our industry. **Job Description**

 We are looking for a talented (
 **Senior Salesforce Administrator)** 
 to join our growing global team at Sectigo.
   

  





  

  

 The Senior Salesforce Administrator manages all assigned aspects of the Salesforce environment at Sectigo. This position is responsible for guiding the ongoing development, improving processes, promoting adoption of the platform, and performing the execution on the day\-to\-day configuration, support, maintenance, and improvement of our Salesforce platform. This individual primarily focuses on a list of assigned regions, as well as interacting with and supports users globally besides collaborating with other Salesforce administrators on the team. This individual works closely with functional leaders, organizational units, and subject matter experts to identify, develop, and deploy new business processes for the sales, marketing, and support departments. This role is a part administrator and heavily supports users on CPQ from assisting with quote creation and working with product management to set up price books/product bundles/approval flows.
   

  





 Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role:
   

  




* Serve as system administrator for the Salesforce.com environment and provide day\-to\-day end\-user support for 300\+ Salesforce users.
* Maintain and support CPQ, collaborating with sales leaders, product, legal, and finance teams.
* Assist with rolling out CPQ to other sales divisions of the company.
* Handle all basic administrative functions including user account maintenance, reports and dashboards, workflows and other routine tasks.
* Improve process around cases for support department to ensure appropriate inputs available for correct routing to agents and essential metadata captured for metrics reporting.
* Complete regular internal system audits and prepare for upgrades.
* Manage Salesforce.com data feeds and other integrations (HubSpot, ZoomInfo, Jira, Jitterbit, etc.).
* Identify, diagnose, and resolve technical problems and track problems appropriately.
* Monitor application storage usage and archive data as needed, maintain data security and integrity.
* Create and customize standard and custom objects, fields (including formula fields), page layouts, security rules, sharing rules, and validation rules.
* Build framework for user profiles, roles, permission sets, assignment rules, and license types.
* Monitor and improve data quality, integrity, and user adoption.
* Work with our institutional management team to establish suitable processes to support administrative, development, and change management activities.
* Leverage expertise to collaborate on best practices/standards supporting platform adoption and the full application lifecycle (design, development, change control, UAT, deployment and support).
* Document current and future state processes and develop functional specifications.
* Promote data integrity, data governance, and compliance. Performs special assignments as requested by departments.
* Assist with building test plans and scenarios to support QA/ UAT efforts.
* Perform data loads and data quality reviews. Hands\-on experience with tools like Data Loader.
* Ability to develop and maintain SFDC Visual Force pages, Apex classes, triggers \& lightning components a plus.
* Develop end\-user training documentation and provide user training for new releases.
* Assist in training new users and grow the Salesforce.com skill set across the organization.
* Other duties as assigned and related to the nature of this role and company initiatives.



 More information about this role:
   

  




* This is a full\-time and in\-office position, reporting to our Chennai office 5 days a week.
* This is an individual contributor role, reporting to our Manager, Salesforce.
* The targeted compensation package for this role is between INR 12,50,000 and INR 13,50,000


**Qualifications**

**Education:**



* Bachelors from an accredited college or university is strongly preferred



**Experience:**



* Salesforce Admin and CPQ specialist certificates are strongly preferred.
* Minimum 5 years of experience as a Salesforce administrator/developer.



**Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications:**



* Proven Salesforce subject matter expert with experience creating reports, optimizing processes, training, and managing dashboards.
* Strong experience with CPQ covering implementation, maintenance of price books, products, and quote/order form templates, and providing training and support for sales teams in building quotes.
* Maintain high standards of data quality for Salesforce records, ensuring accuracy and consistency.
* Ability to customize and configure Salesforce Communities to meet business requirements, including branding, page layouts, and user permissions, is a plus.
* Experience with Cases and understanding of their workflows and accessibility rules.
* Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines, handle and prioritize simultaneous requests, and manage laterally and upwards.
* Creative and analytical thinker with strong problem\-solving skills.
* Must demonstrate exceptional verbal and written communication skills at all levels of the organization.
* Ability to assess the impact of new requirements on Salesforce.com and all upstream and downstream applications, systems, and processes.
* Excellent planning, organization, attention to detail and time management skills including the ability to support and prioritize multiple projects.
* Strong interpersonal skills, experienced building strong cross\-functional working relationships.
* Strong business acumen and understanding of marketing and sales processes on experience.
* Strong computer aptitude and proficiency in MS Office applications is a must.
* Ability to work in a global, fast\-paced environment.


**Additional Information**

**Sectigo is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**




 At Sectigo, we are committed to providing equal opportunities throughout your career. We hire and promote the most qualified individuals based on their skills, experience, job requirements, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the countries where we operate.
   

  





 Our “One Sectigo” culture fosters a strong sense of belonging and supports a respectful, inclusive workplace free from discrimination and harassment.

**Global team. Global reach. Global impact.**

Our commitment to engagement is rooted in an unconditionally inclusive workforce, embodying our unique perspectives, heritages, and backgrounds, all as diverse as the experiences of each Sectigo employee. title: Risk Analytics - Product Analyst - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS \- Delivery Excellence Senior position**
 Within last decade, cost of delivery and Delivery excellence has become the most critical factors to run successful and popular businesses spread around the globe. To support such a dynamic and fast paced IT transformation industry, we are using various cutting\-edge Delivery Excellence models and tools with relentless focus on automation to offer best in class and tailor\-made solutions to our clients.
   

  

 As a part of our global team you will be part of GDS projects as Delivery Excellence management professional. You will be involved in working on challenging problems and creating next generation delivery excellence platforms.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Are you a detail driven professional with a passion for translating business needs into impactful product experiences? Do you thrive at the intersection of people, process, and technology? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join our Product team and help shape solutions that deliver real value to our clients and users.
   

  

 In this role, you’ll serve as a critical bridge between the business stakeholders and the development and engineering teams. Your work will influence how ideas become features, how features become products, and how products deliver meaningful outcomes in a fast paced, evolving environment.
   

  

 As a key member of the Product team, you will play a hands on role in defining business requirements, crafting user stories, and ensuring that technical execution aligns seamlessly with business objectives. You will lead user acceptance testing (UAT), drive iterative testing cycles, validate enhancements, and ensure that issues or defects are accurately identified, tracked, and resolved. Your keen eye for detail and strong communication skills will help ensure that every release meets the highest standards of quality and functionality.
   

  

 This is a client facing and user centric role where you will engage with stakeholders, address queries, clarify requirements, and ensure that feedback is incorporated into continuous product improvements. You’ll gain a deep understanding of real world user behaviors, business processes, and product journeys—making this the perfect place to grow as a product focused business professional while driving meaningful impact across the product lifecycle.
   

  

 If you’re energized by the opportunity to influence product development end to end, collaborate with cross functional teams, and help bring scalable, user friendly solutions to life, this role provides the platform for you to make a lasting difference.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements, ensuring alignment across stakeholders, product managers, and engineering teams.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by testing the defined test cases, validating functionality, and ensuring readiness for release.
* Support in iterative testing cycles, identifying defects, documenting issues, validating fixes, and performing regression testing as needed.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
* Serve as one of the primary liaison between business teams and engineering, providing clarifications, resolving requirement gaps, and ensuring shared understanding throughout the product lifecycle.
* Review and validate bug fixes, ensuring that resolved issues meet expected outcomes before closure.
* Engage with clients and end users, addressing queries, troubleshooting issues, and gathering feedback for continuous improvement.
* Support product rollout activities, including release planning, communication, and training support where required.
* Monitor product performance post release, identify enhancement opportunities, and contribute to backlog prioritization.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation including requirement specifications, UAT plans, test results, and user feedback logs.
* Support product strategy, roadmap planning, and end\-to\-end product lifecycle management for Internal Controls and Audit solutions.
* Partner with stakeholders across business, risk, audit, and technology teams to gather requirements and drive product adoption.
* Own MIS, reporting, KPI tracking, and executive dashboards to measure product performance and business outcomes.
* Analyse large datasets to derive insights, identify control gaps, and support decision\-making.
* Drive product implementation, rollout, user onboarding, and change management initiatives.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to define functional requirements and prioritise product backlogs.
* Identify automation and AI opportunities to enhance audit and internal control processes.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Risk Assessment – Assessment of internal processes to identify findings, vulnerabilities, and control gaps/deviations identified across applications and infrastructure.
* Control Monitoring / Testing \- Understanding of controls around Business processes, ITGC, Cyber, Data protection and privacy to perform testing of design and operational effectiveness of controls.
* Ability to create process documentation.
* Ability to understand business problems in Risk/Finance and contribute to translating them into solution or product requirements.
* Exposure (through projects or roles) to Risk, Finance, Supply Chain Operations (SCO), or related business functions preferred.
* Demonstrates interest in AI/analytics\-driven Risk solutions and their business applications.
* Agentic AI architecture\- Design agentic AI system architectures and define associated technical guardrails.
* Functional understanding of foundation models (LLMs) and associated risks. Awareness of the AI deployment lifecycle
* Control Automation – Identify automation opportunities using analytics platform to monitor the operational effectiveness on the regular basis.
* Basic exposure to Presales, solutioning, proposal support, or client presentations is a plus.
* Interest in working in tech\-enabled or AI\-led Risk products/solutions environment.
* Ability to support senior team members in product development, go\-to\-market efforts, and client engagements.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with business delivery teams.
* Analytical thinking.
* Strong team\-player and self\-started attitude.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, global delivery environment with distributed teams.
* Well organized, attentive to details attitude.
* Open to hiring across locations, aligned with EY’s Global Delivery Services (GDS) model.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Overall 3\-6 years of experience in Risk Advisory (preferably Internal Controls) experience with Big 4 or comparable professional services environment
* CA or Master’s degree in Business Administration or Risk management
* Good to have certifications – CISA, CISM, CIA, AIGP, ISO 42001, CISSP, CRISC, CCSK, ISO 27001, and others (as relevant)
* Any 1 hard tech skill is a must – Either Python or Databricks Or full stack or AI
* Product Management experience with demonstrated ownership of delivering business solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Experience in reporting, MIS, analytics, and data\-driven decision making.
* Hands\-on experience in product implementation and deployment.
* Domain expertise in Internal Controls, Risk, Compliance, or Audit (mandatory).


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 250\+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Temenos Data Hub (TDH) Business Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
 Telecom Network Engineer ISG role focuses on designing and enhancing secure and scalable telecom integration solutions using IRIS API Framework Extensibility Framework T24 AA Technical T24 OFS and Admin and TAFJ. The role involves hybrid work model and day shift to support cards and payments platforms while ensuring resilient connectivity and efficient transaction processing.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design robust telecom integration solutions that connect T24 AA Technical components with IRIS API Framework to support reliable cards and payments transaction flows
* Develop scalable service orchestration using Extensibility Framework so that telecom network endpoints and TAFJ based applications exchange data efficiently and securely
* Configure and optimize T24 OFS and Admin interfaces to ensure telecom channels handle high volume card authorization and settlement messages with minimal latency
* Monitor telecom network performance metrics to identify bottlenecks affecting cards and payments processing and implement targeted improvements that enhance customer experience
* Collaborate with application teams to align telecom routing rules with IRIS API and TAFJ services ensuring consistent behavior across switching clearing and settlement processes
* Troubleshoot complex production incidents across telecom links T24 AA Technical modules and IRIS APIs to minimize downtime and safeguard critical payment operations
* Implement configuration baselines and version management for telecom nodes and T24 related services to maintain predictable behavior across hybrid environments
* Coordinate with security and compliance stakeholders to embed secure connectivity practices for cards and payments data flows across IRIS API Framework and telecom infrastructure
* Participate in capacity planning exercises to ensure telecom resources OFS gateways and TAFJ components are sized for peak transaction loads and future growth
* Document network topologies interface specifications and operational runbooks for telecom integration with T24 and cards and payments systems to support efficient knowledge transfer
* Execute day shift operational support activities that include health checks log analysis and preventive maintenance on telecom nodes and integration endpoints
* Engage with business and technology partners to understand upcoming cards and payments initiatives and translate them into telecom and integration requirements for ISG
* Optimize hybrid work practices by using collaboration tools and standardized procedures so that onsite and remote activities smoothly support telecom and T24 operations


**Qualifications**
* Exhibit strong proficiency in IRIS API Framework with hands on experience designing and supporting telecom integrated services for financial transaction processing
* Demonstrate deep knowledge of Extensibility Framework by configuring and customizing extensions that integrate telecom events with T24 AA Technical modules
* Apply advanced skills in T24 AA Technical and T24 OFS and Admin to build and maintain interfaces that support real time cards and payments services
* Utilize solid expertise in TAFJ to implement and troubleshoot middleware components that connect telecom gateways with core banking engines
* Bring proven domain experience in cards and payments including authorizations clearing settlement and dispute flows within telecom dependent environments
* Use effective communication and documentation abilities to collaborate across cross functional teams in a hybrid work model while following structured processes
* Employ analytical and problem solving capabilities developed over six to nine years of experience in telecom or financial technology integration roles

title: Oracle EBS P2P GL Functional Senior Business Analyst

The overall objective of this role is to contribute to continuous iterative exploration and investigation of business performance and other measures to gain insight and drive business planning.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities:**
 The candidate will execute a wide range of Enterprise Application enhancements / Implementations / upgrade and support activities within Technology Organization / Supply Chain functions, both quantitative and qualitative in nature to support program management.
   

  

* As a lead business analyst, is expected to work on requirement gathering, solution design, configuration and end\-to\-end validation of setups to delivery high quality solution to meet our delivery commitments.
* Will be responsible for working with Operations/Finance and business stakeholders.
* Knowledge on AI tools, application of AI enablement for P2P processes

* Assist in training / recruiting contract resources.

description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

**Position title: Analytics \& Intelligence \- Lead / Senior Analyst (Medical Analytics)**
**Roche India \- Roche Services and Solutions**
**Reports to: Analytics \& Intelligence – Manager**
**Location: Hyderabad \& Chennai**
 A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
   

  

 That’s what makes us Roche.
   

  

 Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics \& technology\-driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe. As a Senior Analyst – Medical Analytics, you will collaborate closely with Field analytics \& Insights \- Medical, U.S. Medical Affairs (USMA) teams. You will play a key role in enabling data\-driven medical strategy and enhancing patient outcomes through advanced analytics.
   

  

**Your Opportunity**
* Lead complex analytics initiatives supporting Medical Affairs across areas such as real\-world data analysis, patient outcomes, treatment pathways, pre \& post launch tracking, customer list generation and disease progression
* Partner with Field Medical and Medical Networks teams to generate insights from HCP/KOL engagement data, enabling optimization of medical strategies and field effectiveness
* Develop and implement scalable data pipelines, automation solutions, and analytical frameworks to process and analyze large healthcare datasets
* Work on analytics use cases spanning HEOR, medical impact assessment, patient journey analytics, and health equity research
* Leverage diverse datasets such as claims, EHR/EMR, clinical trial data, and interaction data (MSL/HCP engagements) to derive actionable insights
* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to translate scientific and business questions into analytical solutions and deliver high\-quality outputs
* Create clear and impactful presentations to communicate complex clinical and scientific insights to stakeholders
* Act as a thought partner by delivering high\-quality, scientifically grounded analytics solutions and recommendations
* Manage end\-to\-end project delivery, ensuring quality, timeliness, and stakeholder alignment
* Work across global teams and time zones to support business needs
* Mentor junior team members and contribute to capability building within the team


**Who You Are**
* You hold a bachelor’s degree in Technology, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Medicine, Biostatistics, or a related discipline, with 4–8 years of analytics/consulting experience, including 2–5 years in Pharma/Biotech/Healthcare analytics. A Master’s degree is an added advantage
* Strong experience in Medical Analytics, real\-world data analysis, clinical analytics, or outcomes research
* Hands\-on experience working with healthcare datasets such as claims, EHR/EMR, clinical trials, and field medical interaction data
* Good understanding of U.S. Medical Affairs ecosystem, including Field Medical, Medical Networks, and Scientific Operations
* Proficiency in SQL and Excel, along with strong programming skills in Python, R, or SAS
* Experience in building data pipelines, automation workflows, and scalable analytical solutions
* Strong understanding of statistical techniques, data modelling, and analytical problem\-solving
* Exposure to therapeutic areas such as oncology, immunology, neurology, etc., is preferred
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex data into meaningful insights
* Demonstrated ability to manage stakeholders and work in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment


 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.

description:
**Job Summary**
 CRD VI Article 21c is an EU regulation impacting non\-EU banks undertaking core banking activities in the EU, with implications for client onboarding, existing client facilities, operating controls and ongoing regulatory compliance. The role will be responsible for supporting the design and delivery of analytics and automation capabilities for the A21c control framework, ensuring that regulatory requirements are translated into practical, scalable and well\-documented control solutions.
   

  

 The role holder will work closely with business, operations, data, technology, risk and compliance stakeholders to gather requirements, assess the impact of Article 21c on client onboarding and existing client facilities, and support implementation of both preventive and detective controls. Preventive controls will include rule engine logic, workflow triggers and reporting layers, while detective controls will include recurring reports, exception monitoring and management information across agreed frequencies.
   

  

 A key focus of the role is to build practical, well\-documented automation components including control data preparation, rules engine requirements, workflow inputs, reporting layers and recurring detective control outputs across agreed frequencies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy \& Planning**
* Support definition of the A21c control framework automation roadmap, including requirements, milestones, dependencies, delivery risks and success criteria
* Translate regulatory and business requirements into structured analytics, data, workflow and reporting requirements for preventive and detective controls
* Ensure the automation approach is scalable, transparent and aligned to client onboarding, existing client facilities and control governance requirements.


**Requirement Gathering and Stakeholder Engagement**
* Conduct structured working sessions with programme, operations, technology, data and control stakeholders to:
* Capture data sources, business rules and control expectations
* Understand the impact of Article 21c requirements on client onboarding, existing client facilities and downstream reporting obligations
* Document requirements, assumptions, gaps, dependencies, decisions and open points in a clear and traceable manner
* Proactively resolve ambiguity where possible and escalate unresolved risks, blockers or design decisions to the appropriate governance forum
* Act as a central analytics SME to connect business requirements with technology delivery and operational implementation


**Automation, Data and Controls Delivery**
* Prepare, profile, validate and analyse large datasets to identify impacted clients, facilities, exceptions and control populations.
* Support design and implementation of preventive controls, including rules engine logic, workflow triggers, control outputs and reporting requirements.
* Develop detective control reporting across agreed daily, weekly, monthly or other frequencies, including exception reporting, reconciliation outputs and management information.


**Risk Management and Control Quality**
* Ensure control logic, data outputs and reporting artefacts are accurate, evidence\-based, auditable and aligned to agreed requirements.
* Identify data quality issues, control gaps, manual dependencies and implementation risks, with timely escalation to relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain discipline around version control, documentation, sign\-offs and issue tracking for control automation deliverables.


**Governance and Documentation**
* Prepare clear business requirements, functional specifications, data definitions, rule logic documentation, testing evidence and implementation notes.
* Comply with applicable data management, model/rule governance, risk, compliance and technology delivery standards.
* Support UAT, production readiness, operating model handover and BAU reporting transition for the control framework.
* Provide consistent progress updates, risks and dependencies for programme governance and senior management forums.


**Regulatory \& Business Conduct**
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.


**Key Stakeholders**
* Article 21c Programme Team
* Client Management, KYC Operations and CIB Operations
* Technology, Data and Analytics Teams
* Regional and Country COO Teams
* Risk, Compliance and Control Owners
* CDO and Other CIB COO Teams


**Skills And Experience**
* Data Preparation and Transformation
* Python / Scripting
* Data Visualization and Reporting
* Rule Engine and Control Logic Design
* Regulatory Control Documentation
* Requirements Management and Stakeholder Engagement


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Data, Technology, Finance, Business, Mathematics, Statistics or related discipline; postgraduate qualification preferred.
* Training in data analytics, regulatory change, controls, client onboarding/KYC or technology delivery preferred.
* Relevant certifications in analytics, data visualisation, Python, Alteryx, Dataiku, Informatica, Agile or project delivery preferred
* Languages: English
* 8 to 10 years of experience in analytics, data transformation, reporting automation, regulatory change, controls implementation or related banking operations roles.
* Strong capability in requirement gathering, data profiling, data validation, reconciliation, exception analysis and translating business problems into analytical solutions.
* Hands\-on exposure to data preparation and analysis tools such as Alteryx, Informatica, Dataiku or equivalent platforms, with strong Python skills preferred
* Ability to design and deliver dashboards, recurring control reports and management information using visualisation tools such as Tableau, Power BI or equivalent

* Strong organizational skills

* Demonstrated understanding of use and application of automation and AI to transform business processes preferred
